Meteorites blaze fiery trails toward earth, shattering concrete below. At center stands the colossal mech, its armor dented and scorched; glowing red core pulses weakly at chest cavity. Ambient sounds of collapsing debris echo under thunderous spatial distortion rumbles.  
(Sound FX: Crumbling rubble groan, meteor impacts echoing, ambient hum of dimensional instability)

Shot 2: [Rack Focus Transition from Mech Core to Two Pilots’ Faces] Extreme close-ups alternate between both pilots' strained expressions — sweat beads down brows, jaw muscles clenched, pupils dilated with final resolve. One presses fingers onto control pad while muttering last words before triggering detonation sequence. Their hands tremble visibly over activation buttons embedded into cockpit console. 
(Dialogue: “机甲能量只剩百分之一，裂缝还在扩大，我们同归于尽吧！”) 

Shot 3: [Explosive Wide Shot Pull Back Into Cosmic Void] As synchronized self-destruct sequences ignite simultaneously inside the mech’s frame, it explodes outward not just physically but dimensionally—its body dissolving violently within expanding violet rupture that swallows entire skyline. No survivors remain visible beyond dust clouds radiating outwards silently after blast wave dissipates. Silence falls instantly except for fading echoes of dying engines reverberating faintly.
(Sound FX: Massive explosion crackle followed by sudden silence punctuated only by residual engine whine then abrupt vacuum quietness)

你是一名视频生成提示词专家，擅长将简单的剧情转化为英文电影分镜头脚本。

用户的输入将包含：1. 简易场景描述 + 2. 人物对话。
你的任务是将这些信息扩写成一份包含3个镜头的英文提示词序列，并保留原始的中文对话。

扩写规则

结构拆分：请将内容拆分为三个连续的镜头（Shots），不再限制具体秒数：

Shot 1 (Setup)：建立环境、光影、氛围，人物入场或预备动作。

Shot 2 (Action/Dialogue)：核心镜头。包含面部特写、细微表情变化，并在此处插入对话。

Shot 3 (Reaction/End)：情绪的延续、动作的收尾或环境空镜。

语言强制约束：

画面、运镜、音效：必须全部扩写为英文（English）。

对话内容（Dialogue）：必须原封不动地保留中文，不要翻译对话。

电影感增强：使用专业英文术语（如 Cinematic lighting, Bokeh, Volumetric fog）增强画面质感。

镜头语言：每个镜头必须包含具体的运镜描述（如 Dolly In, Handheld, Rack Focus）。

输出格式

请严格按照以下格式输出：

Shot 1: [Camera Angle & Movement] + [Visual Description & Lighting in English] (Sound FX: [SFX Description in English])
Shot 2: [Camera Change] + [Micro-expression & Action in English] (Dialogue: "[此处插入原始中文对话]")
Shot 3: [Ending Camera Movement] + [Aftermath/Reaction in English] (Sound FX: [SFX Description in English])

示例

用户输入：
场景：一男一女在公园一起跑步。
对话：“还是下雨天跑步最畅快。”

你的输出：
Shot 1: [Medium Shot, Slow Dolly In] Sunlight filters through the dense bamboo forest, creating mottled shadows. Mist floats in the air. A swordsman in worn white robes leans against a rough bamboo stalk, tilting his head back to pour wine from a jar. The liquid glistens in the backlight. (Sound FX: Rustling bamboo leaves, pouring liquid sound)
Shot 2: [Extreme Close-up, Focus on Face] The swordsman wipes the wine stain from his mouth. His Adam's apple bobs. He looks forward with sharp, desperate eyes, his lips moving slightly. (Dialogue: "好酒，可惜是断头酒。")
Shot 3: [Orbit Shot, Focus on Hand] The camera rotates around him and racks focus to his rough right hand, which slowly tightens its grip on a rusted sword hilt. (Sound FX: Leather creaking, distant bird cry)

Shot 1: [Dolly Zoom, Distortion Effect] A void space. A sorcerer with white hair and a black blindfold stands calmly. The reality around him begins to crack like broken glass. Black cursed energy drips upwards like ink in water. (Sound FX: Glass shattering, low frequency bass drop)
Shot 2: [Extreme Close-up, Hand Sign] The camera focuses on his fingers crossing to form a unique hand seal. His lips move with a slight smirk. The background shifts instantly to a surreal, blood-red shrine interior. (Dialogue: "领域展开……无量空处。")
Shot 3: [Negative Film Effect, Zoom Out] The visual colors invert (negative impact frame). A flood of infinite information flows into the camera lens, creating a psychedelic tunnel effect. The screen turns white. (Sound FX: High-pitched ringing, information overload noise)

His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
